document: Green Means Go - Inventory Database Mapping

executive_summary.one_paragraph: Green Means Go builds every farm assessment from one shared on-farm model that is now crop- and region-aware: the Rust kernel computes IPCC 2019 soil N2O with explicit fertiliser N contents, crop-residue N from Table 11.1A (or the generic row with a crop dry-matter fraction), region climate parameters for six regions (GH, NG wet; SN, BF, ZA dry; CA aggregated), cocoa and oil palm are treated as perennials, and fuels, irrigation, seed, pesticides (by active ingredient), packaging and transport are now real inputs. Purchased inputs are matched to AGRIBALYSE 3.2 / ecoinvent 3.11 behind a product-identity gate and a deterministic ranking. Of the 174 matcher rows that existed at 45ad6b6, 75 now resolve to a different dataset, mostly corrections (every wrong-crop raw material that resolved to Ghana cocoa, petroleum or a Canadian crop now finds its own crop). 564 rows are new (new regions SN, BF, ZA and CA farm, and new inputs). Foreground water is characterised with country AWARE CFs and on-farm land with country LANCA CFs under EF 3.1. Remaining problems are a handful of unflagged wrong-product matches, mostly in ZA, and three waste/biogas inputs excluded by unit mismatch.

per_commodity.cocoa: Farm: perennial (3 + 22 years, permanent-crop land, generic residue row, DRY 0.925). Processing: cocoa beans -> ecoinvent 'cocoa bean production, sun-dried' (Ghana for GH, RoW elsewhere); default ratio 1250 kg beans per tonne powder or butter. Cocoa butter as an ingredient matches a French consumer-stage proxy.
per_commodity.palm_oil: Farm: perennial (3 + 22 years), generic residue row. Processing: FFB / fresh fruit bunch / palm fruit -> ecoinvent 'palm fruit bunch production' RoW in every region (no African dataset); default OER 0.20 (5000 kg FFB per tonne CPO); crude palm oil -> WFLDB GLO.
per_commodity.maize: Farm: IPCC Table 11.1A Maize residue row, FAO seed 25 kg/ha, water need 650 mm, yield guides GH/NG/SN/BF/ZA. Processing: maize grain production (RoW; South Africa for ZA; Canada, Quebec for CA). Seed input matches 'market for maize seed, for sowing' (GLO); seed for sowing and grain are distinct products in the identity gate.
per_commodity.groundnuts: Farm: IPCC Peanuts residue row, seed 80 kg/ha; legume credit only for neighbours. Processing: now 'peanut production' RoW in every region (was cocoa / pea at 45ad6b6); groundnut oil -> Agribalyse peanut oil {SN}.
per_commodity.honey: Farm: REJECTED (HTTP 422). Processing: raw honey -> WFLDB small-scale honey {CH}, flagged proxy (was cocoa, petroleum, maple syrup).
per_commodity.tomato: Farm: generic residue row with DRY 0.055, nursery seed (carrot seed proxy), water 600 mm. Processing: tomato production, processing grade, open field (RoW).
per_commodity.eggplant: Farm: generic residue row DRY 0.077, seed and water defaults. Processing: 'aubergine production, open field' (RoW) for eggplant, aubergine, garden eggs and brinjal in every region (was cocoa in GH).
per_commodity.cucumber: Farm: generic residue row DRY 0.048. Processing: only 'cucumber production, in heated greenhouse' (GLO) exists: proxy for open field.
per_commodity.chilli_peppers: Farm: generic residue row DRY 0.12, pepper seed and water defaults. Processing: 'chilli production' (RoW) for chilli, hot pepper and scotch bonnet (was cocoa in GH).
per_commodity.bell_peppers: Farm: generic residue row DRY 0.061. Processing: 'bell pepper production, open field' (RoW) (was cocoa in GH).

top_data_quality_issues: Fixed after the first six-region run (WS4 follow-up): burned-fuel inputs now always match a combustion ('burned in') dataset (ZA had matched import/supply datasets); BF grid now matches the 'Africa' (RAF) low-voltage market group, never South Africa; ZA copper fungicide matches copper oxide, glass and film packaging match the material (not a waste stream); reverse-osmosis water matches deionised water; maize seed matches maize seed for sowing.

Fixed: incineration and anaerobic-digestion waste now match the kg-referenced (waste) output of the treatment activity, and biogas matches 'anaerobic digestion of manure | biogas' (m3) instead of digestate; no executed row is excluded for a unit mismatch any more.
Bio-fertilizer, Foliar Fertilizer and 'None' fertiliser have no dataset: needs_review in all regions.

Hydro and wind electricity have no dataset for GH, NG, SN or BF: they now fall to the Rest-of-World dataset (ZA and CA use their own); the matcher steps down the region preference list (country, Africa/RAF, RoW, GLO) instead of taking an unranked foreign location.
No African farm-gate datasets for most crops in scope: RoW datasets are used (cocoa GH is the exception).
Perennial lifetimes and the organic-fertiliser 3% N are screening values.

how_this_was_produced.method: scripts/regenerate_inventory_mapping.py executes the engine's own extraction code (engine/inputs.extract_purchased_inputs, engine/process_inputs.extract_processing_inputs, engine/commodities.flag_processing_raw_materials, engine/fuels.expand_fuel_inputs) on small synthetic requests, one per wizard branch, and resolves every resulting input with FarmLCA.resolve_input for GH, NG, SN, BF, ZA and CA with GMG_LLM_ADJUDICATE=0. Query vectors come from the pinned cache engine/golden/matcher_query_embeddings.npz; unpinned queries were embedded live once and cached (--query-cache) for the final run. The previous match is read from the mapping committed for 45ad6b6 through engine/test_matcher_regression.collect_rows(). Prose sections were re-verified by hand against the current code; their file:line citations are resolved by pattern search at generation time or remapped from 45ad6b6 with a line-level diff and checked.
how_this_was_produced.canonical_store: data/canonical/lca_engineer.sqlite: AGRIBALYSE 3.2 + ecoinvent 3.11 Cutoff processes, ecoinvent 3.11 method pack, GMG regionalised AWARE / LANCA flows.
how_this_was_produced.matching_method: Cosine similarity of openai text-embedding-3-small vectors; product-identity gate (engine/product_identity.py) before region preference; ranking (production-system fit, region rank, -score, uid). Scores in this file are cosine similarities rounded to 2 dp.

how_to_read.input_name: The text the software builds from the user's form (or the user's free text) and sends to the matcher.
how_to_read.matched_process / by_region: The background LCI dataset in the canonical store that the input is resolved to (the 'consequential data'). Its full cradle-to-gate inventory is then solved and characterised.
how_to_read.on_farm_field_flows: Direct emissions computed by the Rust kernel (N2O, nitrate, CO2 from fuel, water, land) and the characterisation factors applied.
how_to_read.crop_specific_data: Values in the software that depend on the crop name. If this list is short it is because the engine is crop-agnostic (see engine_architecture_summary).

farm_production_support_status.generic_inventory_with_crop_hooks: Runs through the shared on-farm model AND the crop name selects crop-specific values (IPCC Table 11.1A residue row or generic row with crop dry matter, FAO seed rate, crop water need, perennial treatment, yield guides, processing hints).
farm_production_support_status.generic_inventory_name_only: Not used in this version: every crop in scope now selects at least its residue parameters.
farm_production_support_status.not_supported (rejected): The farm API rejects the commodity with HTTP 422 (honey / apiculture).
farm_production_support_status.note: Crops without a Table 11.1A row use the IPCC generic row with a crop-specific dry-matter fraction; the kernel reports this as a warning.

how_to_read.matched_process_at_45ad6b6: The dataset the same row resolved to in the mapping generated at 45ad6b6 (name, location, uid when it was recorded); 'not run at 45ad6b6' for new regions and new rows. changed_vs_45ad6b6 compares uids when known, else name and location.
how_to_read.needs_review / review_reason: Set by the matcher when no dataset in the store carries the input's product identity; the returned dataset is then the most similar one and must be confirmed.
how_to_read.unit_check: Executed engine.units.to_ref_unit on the input against the matched dataset's reference unit: 'same unit', the conversion note, or UNIT MISMATCH (input excluded from the result).
how_to_read.notes: Reviewer notes generated by the script from the executed match (REVIEWER_NOTES in scripts/regenerate_inventory_mapping.py): wrong-product or proxy matches that the identity gate lets through.

determinism.two_live_runs: 733 of 738 matched uids identical; differing rows: ['farm|CA|irrigation pumping (electric)', 'farm|CA|solar PV electricity (on-farm)', 'processing|CA|solar PV electricity (on-site)', 'processing|NG|wind', 'processing|SN|wind']. Each differing pair is the same product in a different location (Canadian sub-national PV and pump variants; non-African wind datasets), i.e. near-equal similarity scores whose order moves with live-embedding jitter for queries not in the pinned cache.
determinism.live_vs_cached_run: 738 of 738 identical when the unpinned query vectors are read back from the --query-cache file (the files were written by this cached run).

validation.store_check: all 115 distinct matched uids exist in the processes table of data/canonical/lca_engineer.sqlite (missing: 0)

code_citation_audit.method: Matcher-row, parameter and table citations are resolved at generation time by pattern search in the current source (scripts/regenerate_inventory_mapping.py cite / cite_def); citations kept from 45ad6b6 were remapped with a line-level diff (45ad6b6 -> working tree); every ref whose cited lines changed was rewritten or dropped by hand.

manual_spot_check.method: random sample of 40 distinct file:line refs (seed 20261112) plus 5 remapped legacy/frontend refs, each opened at the cited lines and compared with the parameter it supports
manual_spot_check.fixed_during_audit: cite_def ranges no longer extend over trailing comment lines (e.g. engine/process_inputs.py _classify_raw_material)

validation.not_validated: Amounts and characterisation-factor values were not re-derived; legacy Rust per-kg factors (inactive by default) were only line-remapped, not re-read.

Organic fertiliser without a declared grade is assumed 3% N; an unrecognised fertiliser type gets 0 N with a warning (no field N2O).
Perennial establishment uses screening lifetimes and input_share 1 unless foods[].establishment is declared; standing biomass carbon is counted only through declared dLUC.
Nigeria uses wet-climate IPCC parameters nationally (flagged in ghana_inherited); ZA uses dry. Per-farm override exists in code (regions.with_climate) but is not exposed in the API.
